description: This file defines an interface IObjectPoolMonitor in the Orleans.Providers.Streams.Common namespace, which includes methods for tracking object pool metrics such as allocation, release, and reporting pool status.

classes.name: IObjectPoolMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring object pool activities, including tracking object allocations, releases, and reporting pool status.

methods.name: TrackObjectAllocated
methods.description: Method invoked when an object is allocated from the pool.

methods.name: TrackObjectReleased
methods.description: Method invoked when an object is returned to the pool.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Method to report the current status of the object pool, including total, available, and claimed objects.
